name: readme-templates-key
body:
README documents the `templates:` key: README.md's deck-layout section documents the optional top-level `kalide.yaml` `templates:` key — it names the deck's external template-library layer, is resolved against the deck root when relative and used as given when absolute, and the deck-root `templates/` directory binds the local layer (layered-template-library). The README's `kalide.yaml` example and key list include `templates:` alongside `title`, `author`, `date`, `theme`, `navigation` and `properties`.

AC: README.md's `kalide.yaml` example and key list include `templates:` with its meaning, consistently with deck-config and layered-template-library.
